title: Nativity! The Musical - review
transcript: it's already one of the nation's favorite Christmas films and I think Nativity the musical is destined to become a fixture on theatres advent calendars for years to come and for this we have to thank the writer and director Debbie is't she wrote and directed the nativity films but before she went into filmmaking she was a renowned theatre writer and director and it shows she knows what works on stage so she's taken the elements that made the film such a hit the story of disadvantaged children attempting to put on a five star nativity show against all the odds the memorable characters the upbeat songs and turned it into perfect theatrical entertainment you smile all the way through and you come out on a cloud this touring production which I saw at Leeds grand theatre is also blessed with an excellent cast especially Simon Lipkin who is very funny as the wildly enthusiastic manchild mr. poppy and the children on whom the show stands or Falls a disciplined well rehearsed total delight you may say this is sentimental light entertainment but it does have something to say about the importance of inspirational teachers it does capture the spirit of Christmas and it is faultless theatre I give it five stars you
